smtp.implicit_tls_alternative: Keep the certificate/key/auth-file settings, set MP_SMTP_REQUIRE_TLS=true, and omit MP_SMTP_REQUIRE_STARTTLS. TLS starts immediately on the configured SMTP port; STARTTLS is disabled.
smtp.client_trust_requirement: Trust the test CA and validate the certificate hostname; successful delivery with verification disabled does not prove authenticated TLS.
configuration_constraints: Providing a certificate/key alone enables optional STARTTLS; require it explicitly for the STARTTLS probe.
Do not set both SMTP_REQUIRE_TLS and SMTP_REQUIRE_STARTTLS.
Do not enable MP_SMTP_AUTH_ALLOW_INSECURE or MP_SMTP_AUTH_ACCEPT_ANY for the authenticated probe.
smtp.password_file_format: One username:password entry per line; plaintext and documented htpasswd hash formats are supported.
smtp.password_file_caveat: The pinned auth parser splits credentials on all whitespace; use generated credentials without whitespace. Restart Mailpit after changing the file. An empty credential input returns without setting credentials, so validate a nonempty file and run wrong/missing-credential negative tests.

api.list_shape: Lowercase messages array, newest first; message entries use ID, To, Subject and Username. To entries contain Address and Name.
api.body_shape: JSON includes HTML, Text, Subject, To and Username; reading this endpoint marks the message read.
api.polling_guidance: Use the exact returned ID after matching a fresh unique recipient and subject; do not rely on latest under concurrent delivery. Keep password-reset URLs and message bodies private.
api.authentication: Set MP_UI_AUTH_FILE to a separate nonempty credential file. UI and read APIs then require HTTP Basic authentication; SMTP credentials are a separate configuration.
api.optional_https: MP_UI_TLS_CERT and MP_UI_TLS_KEY enable HTTPS on the UI/API listener.
